paragraphs.text: Master Dosan (DOH-sahn; Japanese: 道 三 ; rōmaji : Dōsan ; literally: "Road Three") was the oldest living kannushi on Kamigawa and perhaps the most revered. He belonged to the sacred order of Jukai Forest .
Each time wanderers entered the forest seeking enlightenment, Dosan was there. waiting for them to arrive. In this way, he met Azusa , the plane's most famous wanderer, and became her teacher.

Dosan's monks, deep in spiritual thought, could walk through the thickest of forests without leaving a mark, even the leaves beneath their feet unaffected by their passing. During the Kami War , Dosan prayed each night to the kami , but the hate he received in return withered his body. As the war raged on, Dosan's teachings to live peacefully with the kami were denounced and eventually mocked.
